_comment: Gateway tool schemas for the 'outbound-ivr-tools' Lambda target. Mirrors outbound_ivr.prompts.TOOLS plus the case_id/call fields the Lambda needs (the Nova Sonic model doesn't see those two; CDK/the agent's MCP binding should inject them, see docs/design.md 'Tools').

tools.name: record_item
tools.description: Save one confirmed piece of missing prior-auth documentation. Only accepted for a key that is one of this case's missing items.

case_id.description: The case this call is working.

call.description: The call UUID, for the evidence record.

value.description: The answer as a short factual statement in the caller's words.

confirmed.description: True only if the caller confirmed the read-back.

tools.name: escalate
tools.description: Stop collecting and hand the call to a human on the payer side.

case_id.description: The case this call is working.

call.description: The call UUID, for the evidence record.

reason.description: Why the call is being escalated. Required, must not be empty.

follow_up.description: Who to follow up with and when, if the caller offered it.

tools.name: complete
tools.description: Finish the call after all items are collected or accounted for. If any of the case's missing items are not yet confirmed, this escalates instead.

case_id.description: The case this call is working.

call.description: The call UUID, for the evidence record.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what the office will send and when.

tools.name: transfer_to_team
tools.description: Bring a human colleague onto the live call (LiveKit mode only). Unlike escalate, the call keeps going: a colleague joins instead of the call ending.

case_id.description: The case this call is working.

call.description: The call UUID, for the evidence record.

reason.description: Why the call needs a person. Required, must not be empty.

summary.description: What the case needs, what has been collected so far, and what's still missing.
